required_feature: target present on both strands (palindrome or paired sites) so that a transient hemimethylated duplex exists; near-complete methylation of the parental strand
evidence: AAGCCCG is non-palindromic and the A1 target exists on one strand only, so replication yields no hemimethylated duplex at the Dam sense; at 24.2% occupancy the parental mark is absent at ~76% of instances and cannot label a strand; B1 finds no replication-coupled occupancy change

required_feature: occupancy that changes with replication: an oriC-proximal gradient while forks are active, and/or a difference between replicating and non-replicating populations
evidence: B1: oriC-distance gradient x timepoint interaction beta=+0.0011/Mb (95% CI -0.0102 to +0.0124, p=0.85) although ori/ter is 4.20 at T1 vs 1.00/1.17 at T2/T3; bound excludes a T1-specific swing >0.90 pp across the 4.27 Mb replichore; culture-level T1-vs-T2/T3 difference -1.93 pp (p=0.145) against a 3.38 pp MDE, and 4mC at AAGCCCG moves the opposite way (+2.69 pp, p=0.005)

required_feature: a repeat tract or invertible segment inside the MTase that switches specificity, giving multimodal per-site occupancy
evidence: 123_phasevar_261104: pglX SCO6627 codon 259/1210 G8 tract measured directly, no multimodality (detection limit minor allele 17-45%); 122_epiallele_261104: no site-level bimodality

required_feature: bimodal per-site occupancy and within-molecule consistency across sites in the same cell
evidence: 122_epiallele_261104: no site-level bimodality; single-molecule consistency is 3.0-3.6% of the bistable prediction, so 24% is stochastic occupancy, not a mixture of two cell states

required_feature: methylation state covarying with transcript level, or a site inside a regulator's binding site whose occupancy gates binding
evidence: R5: no correlation exceeds |rho|=0.088 (the 80%-power floor); 22 TF/NAP occupancy tracks all negative after GC matching; 0 of 6 gene sets give a gene at FDR 5%. B5 adds: within coding-strand sites occupancy~log2TPM OR 0.99 (95% CI 0.93-1.06, p=0.78 at T1) and within template-strand sites OR 0.93 (p=0.36); coding x log2TPM interaction p=0.70/0.75/0.98

required_feature: 6mA altering local DNA mechanics or NAP binding; usually inferred from clustered placement or from direct biophysical measurement
evidence: spatial concentration is explained by local GC and depth (raw KS p=1.2e-3, window overdispersion p=4.0e-10, island depletion OR 0.485 all p>=0.35 under matched nulls), and NAP/TF occupancy is negative after GC matching; but no biophysical measurement of curvature or protein affinity exists in this dataset, so the mechanism is untested rather than excluded

required_feature: an infection or host-interaction phenotype attributable to the mark
evidence: S. coelicolor M145 is not a pathogen and no infection model was run; the category is inapplicable to this design rather than tested

required_feature: 6mA enriched on mobile-element or genomic-island sequence relative to the host genome
evidence: genomic-island depletion (OR 0.485) does not survive the GC/depth-matched null (p>=0.35); the unassigned 6mA fraction falls in no rRNA or tRNA gene and shows no island enrichment after adjustment

required_feature: a surface-attachment or aggregation phenotype attributable to the mark
evidence: no biofilm assay in this study; untested rather than excluded

required_feature: occupancy that changes across a developmental or metabolic transition
evidence: R5: occupancy flat across T1-T3 spanning the metabolic transition (AAGCCCG A1 24.21-26.24%, this lane 24.29/26.28/25.17%); retention 78-96% between timepoint pairs; a null resampling at observed depth produces as many dynamic sites as observed

required_feature: alignment of marks or of occupancy change with biosynthetic gene clusters
evidence: R5: 29 antiSMASH regions, 18 tests, nothing survives correction; interior-to-flank level ratios 0.73-1.18; within a region mark number is set by recognition-sequence content

required_feature: near-complete self-methylation of every target (reported 78.8-99.9% for BREX, median 99.43% over 63 per-motif values from 14 methylome studies) and a cognate cleaving nuclease that makes incomplete marking lethal
evidence: occupancy 24.2% (45.84% at the most favourable 5' context); all four experimentally determined BREX recognition sequences are 6 bp with 6mA at position 5, against 7 bp at position 1 here; B4: both PglX candidates that carry cognate nuclease machinery are excluded on independent grounds, and no other candidate clearing the 348 aa floor has a demonstrated cognate nuclease
